spawn_objects.description: Creates an object in the simulation environment at specified coordinates.

parameters.coordinates: 3D coordinates [x, y, z] for object placement
parameters.name: Custom name for the object (optional)

move_robot.description: Moves the robot to specified coordinates.

parameters.coordinates: 3D coordinates [x, y, z] to move to

pickup_and_place.description: Picks up an object and places it at specified coordinates.

parameters.object_name: Name of the object to pick up
parameters.arm: Which arm to use ('left', 'right', or null for automatic)

get_placement_surfaces.description: Returns information about available surfaces for object placement.

spawn_in_area.description: Spawns an object on a specific named surface with optional offsets.

parameters.surface_name: Name of the surface to place on (required)
parameters.name: Custom name for the object (optional)
parameters.offset_x: X-axis offset from center of surface (null for random)
parameters.offset_y: Y-axis offset from center of surface (null for random)

spawn_in_area.example: spawn_in_area object_choice=cereal surface_name=kitchen_island_surface color=green offset_x=0.2 offset_y=-0.1

pick_and_place_on_surface.description: Picks up an object and places it on a specific surface with optional offsets.

parameters.object_name: Name of the object to pick up (required)
parameters.surface_name: Name of the surface to place on (required)
parameters.offset_x: X-axis offset from center of surface (null for random)
parameters.offset_y: Y-axis offset from center of surface (null for random)
parameters.arm: Which arm to use ('left', 'right', or null for automatic)

pick_and_place_on_surface.example: pick_and_place_on_surface object_name=cereal1 surface_name=kitchen_island_surface offset_x=0.1 offset_y=0.2 arm=right

get_world_objects.description: Retrieves all objects in the world with optional filtering by type and area. By default excludes floor, wall, ceiling, ground, kitchen, apartment, and pr2 objects.

parameters.exclude_types: List of object types to exclude (optional, defaults to ['floor', 'wall', 'ceiling', 'ground', 'kitchen', 'apartment', 'pr2'])
parameters.obj_type: Type of object to filter by (optional)
parameters.area: Area name to filter objects by (optional)
